Prevention: Dig or plough immediately after harvest to expose the pupae to predatory birds, other natural enemies and the heat of the sun.
Removal of weeds and plants which serve as alternate hosts.
Monitoring: The larva bores into the terminal buds and shoots and tip of the stem
The tender leaflets emerging from central spindle will show shot-hole symptoms initially
In severe infestation emerging leaflets will have only the midribs or several oblong feeding holes
Direct Control: Application of any one of the following sprays.
Neem seed kernel extract 5% (50 ml/litre of water) and neem oil @ 3% 30 ml/ litre of water).
Restrictions: Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators.
Spray any one of the following chemicals.
Cypermethrin 25% EC (1 ml/ litre) at fortnightly interval from flower bud imitation.
